title: Discover Hope
summary: Learn. Connect. Discover Your Next Step.
description:
Learn. Connect. Discover Your Next Step.


Discover Hope is an opportunity to learn more about Hope Church-our story, our mission and vision, what we believe, and how we're structured.


During this time, you'll discover what it means to partner with Hope, have the opportunity to ask questions, and learn more about now you can take your next step in becoming part of our church family.


Come discover who we are, why we're here, and how you can be a part of what God is doing through Hope Church.

We will consider what the church is, why it matters, and how it is designed to function as the body of Christ. Throughout the course, we will explore the biblical foundation for the church, its mission in the world, and its role in shaping our faith and community. title: The Compassion Experience
summary: Step inside a life-changing journey. The Compassion Experience is an interactive walk-through trailer that puts you in the shoes of a child living in poverty — from their home, to their…
description:
Step inside a life-changing journey. The Compassion Experience is an interactive walk-through trailer that puts you in the shoes of a child living in poverty — from their home, to their school, to the moment sponsorship changes everything. It's a free, family-friendly experience that takes about 20–25 minutes to walk through, and it's open to everyone, whether you're part of our church family or just visiting for the day.


After you walk through, you'll have the opportunity to meet a specific child waiting for a sponsor and, if you feel led, begin a sponsorship that changes a child's story forever.


No registration required to walk through — just stop by! Bring your family, bring a friend, and come see hope in motion.

title: The Compassion Experience
summary: Our biggest day for the Compassion Experience!
description:
Our biggest day for the Compassion Experience! This is a fully immersive, interactive walk-through trailer that lets you see — and feel — what daily life looks like for a child growing up in poverty, and how a sponsor's love and support can completely change that story.


The experience is free and open to the whole community, with plenty of time throughout the day to bring your family, your small group, or invite your neighbors along. After walking through, you'll have the chance to meet a child in need of a sponsor and take the next step in changing a life in Jesus' name.


Stop by anytime between 10 AM and 6 PM — no appointment needed.

title: Woven Retreat 2026
summary: WOVEN Women’s Retreat Weekend Rooted • Restored • Redeemed • Flourish
description:
WOVEN Women’s Retreat Weekend
Rooted • Restored • Redeemed • Flourish


Join us for a beautiful weekend in the Smoky Mountains designed for women who are longing to slow down, reconnect with God, and experience true renewal.


Throughout the weekend, we will journey through four intentional sessions:


Rooted — establishing our lives firmly in Christ
Restored — finding healing, rest, and refreshment
Redeemed — embracing God’s grace and purpose
Flourish — walking confidently in the life He has called us to


From Friday evening through Sunday morning, this retreat is designed for completion — creating space to step away from the noise and fully engage in what God wants to do in your heart.


We’ll stay together in a beautiful Smoky Mountain cabin, surrounded by peaceful views, meaningful conversations, worship, teaching, and intentional community.
 
Space is limited - Waitlist will be started if necessary


Cost: $200 total
• $50 non-refundable deposit required to reserve your spot 
• Balance due in 4 installments:
 June 1st | July 1st | August 1st | September 1st


Come expectant. Leave renewed.

title: The Compassion Experience
summary: Join us for the final day of the Compassion Experience, right here on our campus alongside our Sunday services (7:30, 9:15, and 11:00 AM).
description:
Join us for the final day of the Compassion Experience, right here on our campus alongside our Sunday services (7:30, 9:15, and 11:00 AM). Before or after you worship with us, take a few minutes to walk through this powerful, interactive trailer experience that puts you face-to-face with the realities of childhood poverty around the world — and the hope that sponsorship brings.


Once you've walked through, you'll have the opportunity to meet a child waiting for a sponsor and take a tangible step toward releasing a child from poverty in Jesus' name.


This is your last chance to experience it before the trailer moves on — don't miss it!

title: Woven Farm to Table Fellowship
summary: Come pull up a chair at our annual Farm-To-Table Woven Fellowship Dinner!
description:
Come pull up a chair at our annual Farm-To-Table Woven Fellowship Dinner! 


We are gathering for a beautiful evening of farm-to-table dining, meaningful conversation, and community. We’ll enjoy a fresh, locally inspired meal surrounded by the beauty of the farm, followed by a cozy bonfire to wrap up the evening under the stars.


Cost is $15 per person to cover your dinner. There will not be childcare for this event.

title: Arc Encounter
summary: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure at the Ark Encounter in Kentucky!
description: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure at the Ark Encounter in Kentucky! Step aboard the incredible life-size replica of Noah’s Ark, explore its amazing exhibits, and experience the story of Scripture like never before. Join Fueled by Hope and enjoy a fun-filled trip of faith, fellowship, and adventure together!

title: 70's Skate Night
summary: On November 7th from 4:30–6:30 PM, Hope Students will be heading to the Johnson City Family Skate Center for a 70s-themed Skate Night!
description: On November 7th from 4:30–6:30 PM, Hope Students will be heading to the Johnson City Family Skate Center for a 70s-themed Skate Night! This high-energy student ministry event invites students to lace up their skates, throw on their best 70s-inspired outfits, and skate to great music in a fun, energetic environment. Whether students are seasoned skaters or just getting started, it’s a welcoming night filled with laughter, connection, and classic vibes. This unique event is all about building community, strengthening friendships, and making unforgettable memories together. For questions or concerns regarding this event, please contact Logan Harris at http://hopejc.org

title: Fueled by Hope Christmas Party
summary: Join us for the Fueled by Hope Senior Adult Ministry Christmas Party on Saturday, December 5th from 5–7 PM in the Auditorium & Lobby!
description:
Join us for the Fueled by Hope Senior Adult Ministry Christmas Party on Saturday, December 5th from 5–7 PM in the Auditorium & Lobby!


We’ll enjoy a catered meal, time together, and a fun gift exchange. If you’d like to participate in the gift exchange, please bring a wrapped gift valued at $10 or less.


Registration is required, and the cost is $12 per person. We’d love for you to come celebrate Christmas with us!

title: Passion 2027
summary: Passion 2027 is a powerful gathering for 18–25-year-olds and their leaders from around the world to worship Jesus, grow in their faith, and be challenged to live boldly for His name.
description:
Passion 2027 is a powerful gathering for 18–25-year-olds and their leaders from around the world to worship Jesus, grow in their faith, and be challenged to live boldly for His name. Together, we'll experience passionate worship, biblical teaching from influential Christian leaders, and a community of believers united with one purpose: making the name of Jesus known. Whether you've attended before or this is your first Passion Conference, this weekend will encourage, equip, and inspire you to follow Christ with greater passion and purpose. 


Join us February 5–7, 2027, as we travel to Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, GA, for an unforgettable weekend together. Cost is $275/person.
